name: Funding Exhaustion Fade
thesis: Perpetual funding is the rent crowded leverage pays to stay on. When that rent reaches a multi-week extreme, the marginal long is no longer a buyer but a holder bleeding carry, so the flow that drove price up has already been spent and the unwind is what remains.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.
